data.name: Fuzail
data.long_meaning: The name Fuzail is derived from the Arabic word 'Fazlah' which means 'grace, honor, and abundance'. The name Fuzail refers to a person who is pious, God-fearing, and possesses a high level of spiritual understanding. In Islamic history, Fuzail ibn Ayaz was a prominent companion of the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) and was known for his piety and wisdom.
